scripts.test: vp run lib:all && pnpm nuxt-pre-fetch test
scripts.test:e2e: vp run lib:all && pnpm nuxt-pre-fetch test:e2e
scripts.clean: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" exec node -e "for (const d of ['dist','.nuxt','playground/.nuxt','playground/.output']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })" && vp cache clean
